usage: jbus ci [-h] [--days DAYS] [--report] [--each] [--notice]
               [field=value ...]

positional arguments:
  field=value  the fields of --notice

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --days DAYS  days to collect and count (14)
  --report     write the week's report and alert
  --each       every project whose config says ci_report = true, and none when
               no project does
  --notice     print the annotation that gives the collector a job's
               telemetry, and read no config
